release.scientific_boundary: V19.6 integrates engine management, offline Python format-adapter assets, deterministic acquisition recipes and qualification controls. It does not claim that all 76 external executables, restricted databases, provider downloads, large model weights or GPU workflows were executed on this Linux builder. An external engine is reported qualified only after exact artifact/licence hashes plus positive and negative smoke evidence pass on the target Windows/WSL2 machine. Existing research-software, clinical, regulatory and external-validation boundaries remain unchanged.
release.hotfix: V19.1 install/run repair, V19.2/V19.3 scientific workflows, V19.4 professional module hardening and V19.5 BioIntel Live Workspace are retained. V19.6 adds the merged Engine Platform Integration without changing protected DTI, LIMS/ELN or instrument modules. V19.6 Windows runtime compatibility hotfix pins setuptools 80.9.0 for ont-fast5-api/pkg_resources and adds install plus RUN_BOTH validation.

recovery: Extract all five matching Step206 ZIP parts into one new folder.
Run INSTALL_WINDOWS.bat; it installs to a stable LocalAppData application folder.
If Python is absent, allow the signed Python 3.11.9 installer or install it manually and retry.
